narr: Scattered thunderstorms developed and move south across southeast Arizona from Tucson eastward during the afternoon and evening. Damaging wind gusts and flash flooding occurred with storms in eastern Pima County, mainly in east Tucson.
ev: One to two inches of rain in less than 1 hour caused flash flooding of washes across roadways in northeast Tucson. One vehicle became stranded in floodwaters near Tanque Verde Rd and Conestoga Ave.

Another 1 to 2 of heavy rain in less than an hour with a 3-hour total of 2 to 4 caused additional flash flooding of washes and roadways on Tucson's northeast side. Three people were rescued when their vehicle was swept down Bonanza Wash near Bonanza Ave. and E Forest Grove Loop.
lsr: FLOODING AT TANQUE VERDE RD AND N CONESTOGA AVE CAUSED A CAR TO STALL AND BECOME STUCK.
